stories.title: BIS notified IS 19850:2026 (Gazette, 18 May; effective 15 May 2026)
stories.body: India's first fuel-quality standard for petrol blends beyond E20, covering E22, E25, E27 and E30.

one_liners: BIS notified IS 19850:2026 (Gazette, 18 May; effective 15 May 2026) — India's first fuel-quality standard for petrol blends beyond E20, covering E22, E25, E27 and E30.
